user.title: Flyt MinSide
user.description: Log in with the e-mail and password of a Flyt MinSide user (not BankID). If you normally use BankID you probably have no password user: register one under "Don't have BankID?" > "Sign up now" on the MinSide login page, then choose "Finn avtale" to link it to your existing Flyt customer. See the README for details.

reconfigure.title: Change Flyt login
reconfigure.description: Change the e-mail and/or password the integration uses to log in to Flyt MinSide. The login is tested before it is saved.

error.no_customers: The login worked, but the user has no access to any Flyt customer.

init.title: Flyt options

data.show_all_passings: Show all passings on the map

init.description: How often to fetch new passings, and what to show on maps. 30 minutes or more is recommended: passings often reach Flyt hours or days late, and very frequent polling of an unofficial API may get the account throttled or blocked.

data_description.show_all_passings: One map point per vehicle and station/quay it passed, with count and total. Use geo_location_sources: flyt in the map card.
